Overview

Chomutov is a city in Ústí nad Labem with a population of 47,000. A North Bohemian city at the foot of the Ore Mountains, featuring a historic old town and the popular Kamencové jezero lake for recreation. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
